responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduler model for the Xilinx PowerPC 405 APU floating-point unit. It declares the issue, add/subtract, multiply, divide, and sqrt resources and assigns reservation and latency rules to rs6000 floating-point instruction classes such as compare, add/sub, multiply, divide, madd/sub, load/store, and sqrt for cpu=ppc405, supplying the RTL scheduler with timing data specific to the external Xilinx FPU pipeline rather than the core integer pipeline models in the generic 40x files.
same_name_distinction: Unlike xfpu.h, this is not a target-option hook header; it is the machine-description scheduler model that defines Xfpu automaton resources and reservation/latency rules for ppc405 floating-point instruction classes.
